name: trim-silence
description: Trim leading and/or trailing silence. SoX_ng 14.8.0.1 has NO silenceremove effect (the name is an ffmpeg filter), so this recipe uses ffmpeg silenceremove; the tail trim runs through an areverse sandwich so only the file ends are touched, never interior quiet passages.

params.min_silence_s: detection window in seconds, 0.01..5 (default 0.1; the filter also drops up to this much of the first/last non-silent audio - inherent behavior)

safety: writes a NEW output under <input dir>/renders/; never overwrites the input
